title: The Old Bike Race
question: 把今天的“旧东西不一定快，但一样热闹刺激”放进旧自行车趣味赛：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Once a year, a race is held for old bikes. A lot of children entered for this race last year, and there was a great deal of excitement before it began. Many of the bikes broke down on the course. A few bikes, however, completed the race. The winning bike reached a speed of fifteen miles an hour. It was very different from a modern bike race but no less exciting.

options.label: A
options.scenario_zh: 说每年都会为旧自行车举行一次比赛
options.english_template: Once a year, a race is held for ___.

options.label: B
options.scenario_zh: 说去年很多孩子参加了这场比赛

options.label: C
options.scenario_zh: 说很多自行车在赛道上出了故障

options.label: D
options.scenario_zh: 说还是有几辆自行车完成了比赛

options.label: E
options.scenario_zh: 说它和现代自行车比赛很不同，但同样刺激
